how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Durgapur Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 21-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Associate-I position at NIT Durgapur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Associate-I position at NIT Durgapur is 21st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a four-year bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or Computer Science Engineering or Technology, or an M.E./M. Tech in these fields.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs 37,000 per month + HRA for selected candidates through national eligibility tests or Rs. 30,000/- + HRA for others.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: You need to apply via email to the specified address, clearly mentioning the post in the subject line, and attaching all required documents.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Associate-I position at NIT Durgapur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting based on the application, followed by a test or interview.

faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Durgapur is located in Durgapur, West Bengal, with the pincode 713209.

faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is NITD/SRCC/SB/AB/EE/2025-26/07/ADV/01/03.
